name: fleet
description: Claude Code supervises a multi-provider fleet of AI coding workers (OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity CLI — Gemini CLI's successor — xAI Grok Build, Cursor CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Qwen Code, Factory Droid, Amp, Claude Code headless, and 75+ providers via OpenCode including DeepSeek and local LM Studio/Ollama models) as background subagents: registry-driven routing by capability, cost, and observed track record; parallel dispatch; per-provider rate-limit cooldowns with cascade fallback; verification-gated acceptance; and an outcome ledger that makes routing smarter with use. NOTE: runs unattended agents (file edits + command execution, no approval prompts) inside your repo — read the README warning before installing; use only in repos you trust. The skill itself follows the Agent Skills open standard and also runs under Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and other compatible supervisors (see install.sh).
